crux: camera geometry (f/pitch and camera height) plus top point (sign apex vs signal-head top); light height = ratio(horizon, vertical VP) x camera height
fault_found: DeepSeek inputs (C3 3.4 in the blend) use f~2727 which with the measured pole VP puts the horizon at y~-477 against the curb VP at -122, and stop at the head top; correct geometry gives 4.99-5.00 (head-only 4.20)
lesson: For a static object's height from an elevated camera, compute camera height by several depth-based routes and the height ratio by the vertical cross-ratio over a range of horizons: errors in horizon cancel between the two factors, so a result stable across the range is robust even when the horizon itself is uncertain.
